adaptation.descriptionVi: Pantheon giữ Q tối đa 4 giây và bị làm chậm 10%. Thả trước 0,35 giây để đâm giáo tức thời theo hướng chọn, gây 20 sát thương cho mọi kẻ địch và hoàn 60% hồi chiêu; giữ qua mốc này để ném giáo thành đạn bay, gây 20 sát thương cho mục tiêu đầu rồi 10 sát thương cho các mục tiêu sau. Cả hai dạng gây 40 sát thương lên kẻ địch dưới 20% máu; các mục tiêu sau của giáo ném nhận 20. Sát thương còn 80% lên quái và 70% lên lính.
gameplayNotes: LOL2D thay 70–190 sát thương và các tỷ lệ SMCK cộng thêm/SMPT bằng 20 sát thương thường, 40 sát thương khi mục tiêu dưới đúng ngưỡng 20% máu; mục tiêu sau của giáo ném giữ giảm 50% thành 10/20. Không áp dụng tăng tiến theo cấp, SMCK hay SMPT.
Giữ nguyên mốc thả 0,35 giây, làm chậm bản thân 10%, dạng đâm tức thời không bị chặn, dạng ném là đạn có thể bị chặn, hoàn 60% hồi chiêu và các quy tắc vận sức/ngắt từ dữ liệu PC nhập.
Nguồn cơ chế: revision 4016044, normalized content hash f638b8f643b6d4e364a21c7c8a4c6f98ae1aaf217f5f0132b301e50a6269d7e9.

description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Pantheon''' [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|charges]] while being [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 10% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Comet Spear's'' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] range after 0.35 seconds of channeling. ''Comet Spear'' can be recast within the duration.
description.text: Active: Pantheon charges while being slowed by 10% for up to 4 seconds to increase Comet Spear's  range after 0.35 seconds of channeling. Comet Spear can be recast within the duration.

description2.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Pantheon''' hurls his spear in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit, [[File:Successfully enhanced damage physical icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] increased against enemies below 20% of their '''maximum''' health but reduced by 50% against enemies beyond the first.
description2.text: Recast: Pantheon hurls his spear in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit, increased against enemies below 20% of their maximum health but reduced by 50% against enemies beyond the first.

description3.raw: Releasing the ability within 0.35 seconds causes '''Pantheon''' to instead thrust his spear in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit, [[File:Successfully enhanced damage physical icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] increased against enemies below 20% of their '''maximum''' health, and refunding 60% of ''Comet Spear's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown. The thrust's damage is not reduced against enemies beyond the first.
description3.text: Releasing the ability within 0.35 seconds causes Pantheon to instead thrust his spear in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit, increased against enemies below 20% of their maximum health, and refunding 60% of Comet Spear's  cooldown. The thrust's damage is not reduced against enemies beyond the first.

description4.raw: ''Comet Spear's'' total damage is reduced to 80% against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] and to 70% against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]].
description4.text: Comet Spear's total damage is reduced to 80% against monsters and to 70% against minions.

description5.raw: If the charge is [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]] or completes without reactivation, ''Comet Spear'' is cancelled and the ability is put on full cooldown but refunds [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] half the mana cost.
description5.text: If the charge is interrupted or completes without reactivation, Comet Spear is cancelled and the ability is put on full cooldown but refunds  half the mana cost.

description6.raw: '''[[File:Pantheon Mortal Will.png|20xpx|border|link=Pantheon#Mortal Will|An icon for Pantheon's ability Mortal Will]] [[Pantheon#Mortal Will|Mortal Will]]:''' ''Comet Spear'' deals 20 – 265.88 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 115% '''bonus''' AD) '''bonus''' physical damage, affected by the previous damage reductions. Consumes the stacks upon recasting.

notes.text:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
Only the ranged version of Comet Spear can be intercepted.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
Comet Spear maintains its casting angle direction in relation to Pantheon if he moves during the cast time.
The following table refers for interactions while Pantheon is channeling:
* Item actives that interrupt and those with cast times as well as Titanic Hydra, Hexflash, and Recall will cause Comet Spear to recast automatically and the active or spell to buffer to cast afterwards.
** Teleport will cancel the channel entirely.
